verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's evidence shows an MCP server and agent-facing API tools that let external AI agents call Stripe's API (docs-35, docs-36), but this is the opposite direction of the story: it's Terminal being controlled by outside agents, not a built-in assistant inside the Terminal product that a user can delegate POS/reader-management tasks to. No evidence of an embedded assistant UI, chat interface, or task-delegation feature within Stripe Terminal itself.
